[[Gil Moriddan]] is one of four collectors in the Diessa Lowlands. Unlike his co-collectors, the trophies he seeks are not common drops in this area.  He collects [[Leathery Claw]]s, which are far more frequently found in regions to the northeast and northwest.

*[[Ascalon]]
